geography: Dissolved union of the fixed Global LME + High Seas set: 66 LMEs and 18 high-seas identities, including identities with no catch. Overlap is counted once. This is the geography represented by that atlas set, not total world-ocean NPP; EEZ waters outside this union are excluded.

reference_geography.geography: Dissolved union of the fixed Global LME + High Seas set: 66 LMEs and 18 high-seas identities, including identities with no catch. Overlap is counted once. This is the geography represented by that atlas set, not total world-ocean NPP; EEZ waters outside this union are excluded.

overlap_audit.area_note: Planar degrees squared diagnose overlap only; physical area is computed by spherical raster-cell integration.

reference_geography.overlap_handling: Exact geometric union after the existing antimeridian and topology repair; fractional cells integrated once.
reference_geography.excluded_system: EEZs are not added. EEZ water outside the LME/high-seas union is outside this reference.
reference_geography.source_evidence: NPPExtraction/METHODS.md sections 6.2, 6.3 and 7; npp/regions.py, aggregate.py, ensemble.py.

overlap_policy: Exact dissolved polygon union; both between-system and within-system overlap counted once.
ensemble_convention: Median of complete union-wide NPP model totals

ensemble_details.label: Median of complete union-wide NPP model totals
ensemble_details.formula: median(NPP_model(fixed union)) over every model scheduled for that year
ensemble_details.note: Models are integrated over one dissolved polygon union, scaled to its gap-filled Antoine–Morel baseline using the existing NPP common-mask ratio method. This is not the sum of regional medians. All scheduled models must have finite union totals.

coverage_warning: Coverage-limited NPP estimate for the fixed atlas union. Source-window water masks vary by year; never-retrieved cells and far nearest-neighbour fills are excluded. This is not complete world-ocean NPP.
missing_policy: Missing annual integrations stay blank. An explicitly selected earliest-year proxy may fill only years before the first available reference year; it must retain its source year and cannot fill internal or later gaps.
